bagPolicy.summary: Shank Hall hasn't published bag policy details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

parking.summary: There's plenty of free street parking in the area. Don't use the nearby lots, and never block the driveway.
parking.quote: There is plenty of free street parking in the area.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Shank Hall. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Shank Hall sells chips and pretzels, and the bar opens with the doors an hour before showtime. Outside drinks are not allowed, but you can bring in food or even order a pizza.
concessions.quote: No outside beverages are allowed inside Shank Hall, but you can bring in food, or even order a pizza.

accessibility.summary: Shank Hall hasn't published accessibility details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

reEntry.summary: Shank Hall hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Advance tickets for many shows are sold through TicketWeb online or by phone, or in person at the box office. The box office is open Tuesdays from 11am to 2pm and on show dates, and takes Visa, MasterCard and cash.
ticketPickup.quote: Our box office is open on Tuesdays from 11am to 2pm and during all scheduled show dates.

gates.summary: Doors open one hour before showtime, so if you arrive earlier you'll wait outside. Capacity is only 300, so get there early.
gates.quote: Doors don't open until one hour before show time.
